events.title: AI cycle will not be slowed by rate hikes, says Morgan Stanley's Lisa Shalett
events.summary: Lisa Shalett, CIO at Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, asserts that the AI cycle will not be hampered by recent interest rate hikes. She discussed this perspective on 'Closing Bell' following the latest Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) decision, providing insights into the equity markets' direction.

articles.headline: AI cycle will not be slowed by rate hikes, says Morgan Stanley's Lisa Shalett

events.title: Why Investors May Want to Buy Procter & Gamble if Consumer Spending Cools
events.summary: As consumer confidence declines, investors may seek resilient stocks. Procter & Gamble (PG) is presented as a strong candidate due to its 70-year history of dividend increases, well-funded dividends, and diversified portfolio of essential consumer staples. Its current stock price is down from its 52-week high, making its dividend yield attractive for income-oriented investors.

articles.headline: Why Investors May Want to Buy Procter & Gamble if Consumer Spending Cools

events.title: Caesars confirms FTC seeks more merger details, two board members step down
events.summary: Caesars Entertainment announced that two board members, Jesse Lynn and Ted Papapostolou, who were appointed at the request of investor Carl Icahn, have resigned. The company also disclosed that both Caesars and Fertitta Entertainment received a second request for information from the FTC regarding their merger, indicating continued regulatory review. Caesars shareholders are set to vote on Fertitta Entertainment's $17.6 billion takeover bid.

articles.headline: Caesars confirms FTC seeks more merger details, two board members step down

events.title: Lockheed Martin gets first batch of Patriot interceptor parts from General Motors
events.summary: Lockheed Martin has received its first shipment of critical Patriot interceptor components from General Motors, less than a month after the two companies signed a manufacturing agreement. This expedited delivery, which traditionally takes months, highlights the Pentagon's push for faster weapons production amid surging global demand for missile defense systems like the Patriot, especially from Ukraine. Lockheed Martin is also significantly investing to scale up its munitions output across several U.S. sites.

articles.headline: Lockheed Martin gets first batch of Patriot interceptor parts from General Motors

events.title: Uranium Royalty Corp. (NASDAQ: UROY) Reports 1530% Net Income Increase to $16.3M Following Sweetwater Acquisition
events.summary: Uranium Royalty Corp. (NASDAQ: UROY) announced a significant financial upturn, reporting a 1530% increase in net income to $16.3 million for the quarter ending July 31, 2026, with diluted EPS rising 900% to $0.10. This growth is largely attributed to $51.0 million in uranium sales, which partially funded the recent Sweetwater acquisition. The company also highlighted ongoing oil and gas exploration on Sweetwater lands and reaffirmed production guidance from partners like Cameco and Paladin Energy.

articles.headline: Uranium Royalty Corp. (NASDAQ: UROY) Reports 1530% Net Income Increase to $16.3M Following Sweetwater Acquisition

events.title: Gladstone Investment backs Global GRAB’s Barrier1 acquisition By Investing.com
events.summary: Gladstone Investment Corporation provided additional capital to its portfolio company Global GRAB Technologies, Inc. to facilitate the acquisition of Barrier1 Systems, LLC. This acquisition expands Global GRAB’s perimeter security product offerings and adds U.S.-based manufacturing capabilities. Barrier1 specializes in anti-ram vehicle barrier systems, complementing Global GRAB's existing solutions for critical infrastructure security.

articles.headline: Gladstone Investment backs Global GRAB’s Barrier1 acquisition By Investing.com

events.title: Automaker Stocks Rally as Rotation Lifts Cyclicals: General Motors Climbs 4%, Stellantis Rises 4%, Ford Gains 3%, Tesla Adds 2%
events.summary: Automaker stocks, including General Motors, Stellantis, Ford, and Tesla, all saw significant gains Thursday morning due to a rotation into cyclical stocks, rather than company-specific news. This movement indicates investors are betting on softer interest rates and steadier consumer confidence, driving capital towards vehicle manufacturers. However, this type of rotation-driven bid can be indifferent to individual company performance and may reverse without a fundamental catalyst.

articles.headline: Automaker Stocks Rally as Rotation Lifts Cyclicals: General Motors Climbs 4%, Stellantis Rises 4%, Ford Gains 3%, Tesla Adds 2%

events.title: Atlantic Coca-Cola Bottling Contributed $753 Million to Iowa Economy
events.summary: A new report reveals that Atlantic Coca-Cola Bottling Company significantly boosted Iowa's economy, contributing $753 million in 2025. The company, one of 61 independent bottlers, operates 10 facilities across five states, employs over 800 people, and has invested more than $40 million in modernizing its operations. Nationally, the Coca-Cola system contributed $85 billion to the U.S. economy and supported nearly one million jobs last year.

articles.headline: Atlantic Coca-Cola Bottling Contributed $753 Million to Iowa Economy

events.title: Builders FirstSource stock hits 52-week low at 58.13 USD
events.summary: Builders FirstSource (BLDR) stock has dropped to a 52-week low of $58.13, a 54% decline from its high, placing it on InvestingPro's Most Undervalued list despite management's aggressive share buybacks. The company reported lower-than-expected Q2 2026 earnings due to a weak housing market and increased costs, and recently saw a leadership change with Gayatri Narayan's departure. Citizens initiated coverage with a "Market Perform" rating, citing concerns over declining single-family housing starts.

articles.headline: Builders FirstSource stock hits 52-week low at 58.13 USD

events.title: Martin Marietta Materials stock hits 52-week low at $491.41
events.summary: Martin Marietta Materials Inc. (MLM) stock has dropped to a 52-week low of $491.41, trading 31% below its high despite a low PEG ratio suggesting undervaluation relative to growth. The company has raised its dividend for 10 consecutive years, demonstrating financial resilience, although InvestingPro's Fair Value analysis suggests it may be overvalued. This comes amidst strategic developments, including a $5.5 billion note issuance to finance the acquisition of Lhoist North America, Inc., which has garnered varied analyst ratings ranging from Neutral to Buy.

articles.headline: Martin Marietta Materials stock hits 52-week low at $491.41

events.title: Vivani Medical announces anticipated October closing of Cortigent merger with ClearOne
events.summary: Vivani Medical (NASDAQ:VANI) expects the merger of its subsidiary Cortigent, Inc. with ClearOne, Inc. (NASDAQ:CLRO) to close in October 2026. The transaction will make Cortigent a wholly owned subsidiary of ClearOne. Vivani Medical will receive 12,500,000 shares of ClearOne common stock as part of the merger, which remains subject to customary closing conditions.

articles.headline: Vivani Medical announces anticipated October closing of Cortigent merger with ClearOne

events.title: What Is Moving Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) Today?
events.summary: Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) is under market scrutiny today as investors assess its performance amidst a central bank rate increase and a more selective trading environment for industrial stocks. The focus is on the company's execution, demand signals, and operational consistency in a market where financing conditions are tightening and economic activity remains resilient but mixed. Company-specific developments and strong operating models are becoming crucial factors for investor confidence.

articles.headline: What Is Moving Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) Today?

events.title: Why Is PepsiCo (NASDAQ:PEP) in Focus Today?
events.summary: PepsiCo (NASDAQ:PEP) is in focus today as markets adjust to a central bank rate increase, shifting the trading landscape to be more selective. The company's performance is being evaluated based on cash distribution consistency, brand durability, pricing discipline, and demand resilience within the dividend stocks category. events.summary: Verizon Communications (NYSE:VZ) is in focus today due to a fresh market reset driven by interest rate changes, making the communication stocks sector more selective. The company's performance will depend on market updates confirming steady demand and disciplined execution, with attention on subscriber trends, network quality, pricing, and cash generation. events.title: Jim Cramer Says Defense Giant Still Too Expensive, Despite $22.9 Billion Tomahawk Missile Deal
events.summary: Despite RTX (Raytheon Technologies) landing a massive $22.9 billion Tomahawk missile deal and having a $289 billion backlog, Jim Cramer believes the stock is still too expensive. He argues that in a rate-hiking environment, the company's high P/E multiple (around 27x or 34x trailing earnings) needs to compress further, leading to more short-term pain for investors. While acknowledging the strong fundamentals and recent contract wins, Cramer emphasizes that the higher discount rates imposed by the Federal Reserve will continue to pressure the stock's valuation.

articles.headline: Jim Cramer Says Defense Giant Still Too Expensive, Despite $22.9 Billion Tomahawk Missile Deal

events.title: Exxon raises 2050 global emissions forecast, sees slower coal decline
events.summary: ExxonMobil's annual energy outlook projects a slower decline in coal use and higher global carbon emissions by 2050 than previously forecast. The company now expects coal to comprise 15% of the world's energy mix by 2050, up from its prior projection, and global energy-related carbon dioxide emissions to reach 30 billion metric tons, significantly above the level needed to limit global temperature increases. This revised outlook, which informs Exxon's investment decisions, does not yet account for the Middle East conflict.

articles.headline: Exxon raises 2050 global emissions forecast, sees slower coal decline

events.title: Erik Lind Sells 30,000 Shares of DHT (NYSE:DHT) Stock
events.summary: DHT Holdings Director Erik Lind sold 30,000 shares of DHT stock for $673,800, reducing his stake by 18.48%. This sale follows the company's strong quarterly results, with EPS exceeding estimates and revenue increasing significantly. DHT also raised its quarterly dividend, offering an attractive yield despite a high payout ratio.

articles.headline: Erik Lind Sells 30,000 Shares of DHT (NYSE:DHT) Stock

events.title: The Biggest Catalyst for Alphabet Stock May Not Be Search
events.summary: Alphabet's stock performance is increasingly driven by its Google Cloud segment rather than its traditional Search business. Google Cloud saw an 82% revenue growth and holds a $514 billion backlog, surpassing Alphabet's entire 2025 revenue, yet the stock trades at a significantly lower P/E ratio compared to competitors like Microsoft and Amazon. Analysts project a 50% upside for Alphabet, with a price target of $504.76, primarily fueled by the accelerating Cloud growth and its undervalued position in the market.

articles.headline: The Biggest Catalyst for Alphabet Stock May Not Be Search

This fall reflects the energy sector's sensitivity to crude oil prices, geopolitical events, and global supply-demand expectations. The company's integrated business model offers some diversification, but its performance remains closely tied to commodity market conditions and operational efficiencies.

events.title: Multidimensional Energy Pathways; The Resilience Imperative; and Stubborn Inflation
events.summary: This S&P Global daily update discusses the need for multidimensional global energy pathways, emphasizing pragmatism and nationally differentiated approaches in energy and climate discourse. It highlights the "Resilience Imperative" in sustainability, noting that ongoing geopolitical events and increased AI-driven power demands are reshaping the balance between energy security, affordability, and sustainability. The article also points to S&P Global PMI data suggesting stubborn inflation may persist into 2027 due to renewed upward price pressures in energy and supply chains, despite a slight cooling in official inflation data.

articles.headline: Multidimensional Energy Pathways; The Resilience Imperative; and Stubborn Inflation
